title: TraceSynth: Generating Production-Quality Kernel Traces with Constraint-Guided Diffusion Models

summary.core_contribution: TraceSynth studies constraint-guided diffusion models for generating realistic kernel traces.
summary.problem: Production kernel traces can be difficult to share or obtain at scale, limiting experimentation and evaluation of trace-analysis methods.
summary.method: The paper combines diffusion-based generation with constraints intended to preserve properties of production-quality kernel traces.
summary.findings: The work proposes a generative approach for kernel-trace synthesis; fidelity measures, constraints, and evaluation results require full-text review.
summary.limitations: The current catalog captures bibliographic evidence but not the full text; quantitative results, implementation details, and paper-specific validity threats require source review.
summary.future_work: Compare synthetic and real traces across kernels, workloads, event distributions, and downstream analysis tasks.
